item.title: Vancouver Canucks deal winger Garland to Columbus Blue Jackets for draft picks
item.description: VANCOUVER — The Vancouver Canucks have dealt winger Conor Garland to the Columbus Blue Jackets ahead of the NHL’s trade deadline on Friday.
